This page logs dated minutes from the team's weekly meetings with the faculty advisor during the Senior Design build semester. Select a meeting to expand its minutes.

<Accordion title="Week 6 — 09/28/2026" subtitle="Website navigation, Weekly Task Plan, and documentation schedule">

**Location:** Zoom, 5:00 PM
**Led by:** Dr. Mayra Socarras
**Purpose:** Review the project website, introduce the Weekly Task Plan, and revise the documentation schedule.

**1. Website Navigation**

- Dr. Socarras noted that the website's homepage did not display the site navigation and classified this as a navigation issue requiring correction.
- Resolution: the homepage header now presents the site's sections, with drop-down menus for the proposal and design pages.

**2. Weekly Task Plan**

- Dr. Socarras introduced the Weekly Task Plan, a new document the team will maintain and keep current on the website.
- In a joint planning session, the team will define the work for weeks 6 through 15 as specific, actionable tasks (build, code, test, and document) rather than general statements, assigning an owner to each task.
- At the end of each week, the team will record the status of every task, any changes of direction, and any outstanding blockers.
- The plan will serve as the first point of discussion in each weekly meeting.

**3. Documentation Schedule**

- Dr. Socarras deferred the documentation deliverables by approximately two weeks, allowing the team to concentrate on building the prototype and finalizing the major design decisions before documenting the project in full.

</Accordion>

<Accordion title="Week 5 — 09/21/2026" subtitle="Timeline check-in and Senior Design document">

**Location:** Zoom, 5:00 PM
**Led by:** Dr. Mayra Socarras
**Purpose:** Check in on progress and the proposal timeline, and introduce the Senior Design document.

**1. Timeline**

- Dr. Socarras told the team to stay observant of the timeline stated in the proposal so as not to lose time.
- The team explained that some activities had been switched around based on priorities, and that the mechanical part's time requirements had probably been underestimated, so the Gantt chart will eventually need to be revised.

**2. Senior Design Document**

- Dr. Socarras told the team to start working on the first draft of the Senior Design document, incorporating the latest changes.
- This is a task for this week.

**3. Progress Update**

- The team communicated its progress to Dr. Socarras, based on the team's logs.

</Accordion>
